questions.stem_text:
Which characteristic is likely a part of a monopoly market but not of monopolistic
competition?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Deadweight loss exists

questions.stem_text: Which of the following will increase wages for tuba makers?

options.A: A decrease in the cost of tuba-making materials
options.B: An increase in the number of graduates at tuba maker training school
options.C: An increase in the tax on tubas
options.D: An increase in the number of tuba maker training schools
options.E: An increase in the price of tubas

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - An increase in the price of tubas

questions.stem_text:
What gives rise to the difference in the aggregate demand for a nontrading or closed
economy from a trading or open economy?

options.A: Differences in taxation policies between economies
options.B: The inclusion or exclusion of foreign direct investment
options.D: Variances in the level of technological advancement
options.E: Variations in the savings rate of the population

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Differences in taxation policies between economies

questions.stem_text:
Why is the Wagner Act (officially the National Labor Relations Act), considered to be
"labor's Magna Charta"?

options.A: It introduced mandatory profit sharing between employers and employees
options.B: It obligated employers to bargain in good faith with a union
options.D: It created a universal pension system for all workers regardless of employer contributions
options.E: It allowed for automatic union membership for all employees in a workplace

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It introduced mandatory profit sharing between employers and employees

questions.stem_text: What is gross private domestic investment?

options.D: Transfer of ownership of existing assets

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Personal investments in real estate
